text:
Priya: Quick heads-up — our regular cross-func roadmap+triage sync on Wed conflicts with a customer onboarding we can't move. Can we either shift this week's slot or run async for agenda items? Agenda this week: RFC-1223 review (15m), batching design review (20m), quick triage (10m), decision-log updates. Need owners for RFC + design.
Marcus: +1 we should avoid double-booking. I can run a 3-option poll: Thu 10am, Thu 3pm, Fri 9am. Which do you prefer? :bar_chart:
Sofia: Thu 3pm is rough for EMEA folks. I prefer Thu 10am or Fri 9am.
Jesse: I can own RFC-1223 review if someone else can take design review. Happy to prep a 5-slide summary and a short code diff link.
Marta: I'm out Wed 8-12 PT for customer calls. Thu 10am works for me but not Fri morning. 
Priya: Thanks — Jesse, would you add the RFC summary to the agenda doc? Link to decision log: https://redwood.internal/decision-log (please add an entry if we land anything)
Jesse: Yep — will add bullets + key callouts by EOD today.
Marcus: Poll (quick):
• Option A: Thu 10:00 — 45m
• Option B: Thu 15:00 — 45m
• Option C: Fri 09:00 — 30m
React with :a:, :b:, :c: or reply.
Sofia: :a: from my side (Thu 10)
Marta: :a:
Priya: :a: — that'll let PM + infra both join.
calendar-bot: Summary: Thu 10:00 has 3 confirmations (Priya, Sofia, Marta). Marcus has conflict with 15:00. Jesse tentatively free. Recommend scheduling Thu 10:00.
Marcus: OK locking Thu 10:00. I'll update the calendar invite and include logical agenda slots: 10-10:15 RFC (Jesse), 10:15-10:35 design review (Sofia), 10:35-10:45 triage (Marcus), 10:45-10:50 decision-log and actions (Priya).
Sofia: Sounds good. For the design review I'll attach a short demo GIF and the perf numbers (seq-latency, p50/p95).
Priya: Can we try a hard cut at 10:45 to keep it tight? If discussion runs over, we'll spin an async follow-up thread and capture action items in the decision log.
Jesse: Agreed. Also pinging @integrations-team: would appreciate a quick signoff if the RFC affects routing; will DM the leads.
Marta: Thanks all — I'll accept the invite. If anything changes, I'll flag before 9am Thu.
Priya: Awesome — thanks for the quick turn. I'll update the agenda doc and assign owners in the doc. See you Thu 10. :thumbsup:
